subject: website
name: ENSjs documentation
summary: The documentation of @ensdomains/ensjs, source public in ensdomains/ensjs. Its pages set a base URL of https://ensjs.ens.eth.link, which Orivon loads from ensjs.ens.eth itself, so its scripts and styles are its own files and no third-party code runs by itself: Level 3. Not judged Level 4: its bundle carries search and feedback forms that post to endpoints, and this judgement did not trace them to the end.
